subject: Approval needed: Senior Billing Ops Lead comp authorization and offer details
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval needed: Senior Billing Ops Lead comp authorization and offer details

Team —

We have a strong finalist for the Senior Billing Ops Lead role (Alex Rivera). Panel feedback is overwhelmingly positive: deep payments reconciliation experience, 6+ years running billing teams, and clear ownership of billing reliability. The candidate expects an offer this week.

Ask: Approval to extend an offer at base $170,000 with a one-time sign-on of $12,000 (total first-year cash $182k) and start date targeted 2026-11-16. This sits at the top of the published comp band for Senior Billing Ops but within the approved FP&A headcount envelope if we earmark the role to Q4 hiring slot H-17.

Notes and attachments: comp band spreadsheet (attached), interview panel notes (attached), candidate resume (attached).

Key constraints:
- Need a headcount code for payroll/chargeback.
- We should confirm relocation assistance policy if needed (candidate may request).
- If leadership wants to cap the signed offer at $165k, can we include a performance-based $10k sign-on installment at 6 months instead?

Please reply with approval or alternative guidance. I will keep TalentBridge (recruiter) on a tight timeline (they asked for decision by EOD Monday).

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Billing & FP&A Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval needed: Senior Billing Ops Lead comp authorization and offer details

Karthik —

Thanks for the write-up and attachments. On headcount: I can authorize slot H-17 for this hire provided total FY26 spend remains within the FP&A hiring envelope. The $170k base + $12k sign-on is acceptable if we treat the sign-on as a one-time discretionary sign-on that comes from the recruiting/hiring pool (cost center 4301). Please confirm the total on-target comp and which budget code you want charged.

If the candidate requests relocation, please limit to a fixed lump-sum up to $7,500 (no ongoing relocation prorations). Also capture a clause that the sign-on is repayable if the employee leaves within 12 months.

Approve moving forward conditional on:
- Karthik confirms budget code (4301 or alternate)
- HR issues offer via DocuSign with repayment clause for sign-on

Marissa
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval needed: Senior Billing Ops Lead comp authorization and offer details

Looks reasonable to me. A couple of operational asks:

1) Please set the offer at base $168,500 and a one-time sign-on of $13,500 (keeps us inside comp band rounding but matches candidate expectation). That yields $182k first-year cash which aligns to what Karthik proposed while giving some flexibility to negotiations.
2) Use hiring slot H-17 as Marissa approved. Charge to cost center 4301 (Marissa confirm).
3) If candidate insists on a higher base, approve up to $172,000 only if we reduce sign-on to keep total cash <= $185k and get written approval from Marissa.

If HR can prepare a DocuSign offer with the repayment clause and a standard 30-day background/credit contingency, I’m comfortable.

Vivek
Head of People Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Liz Harrington <liz@talentbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alex Rivera — expected ask and counter

Karthik —

Quick update from Alex: he is excited and would like to move quickly. His counter: prefers $175,000 base with $10k sign-on (total first-year cash $185k), and requests a $5k lump sum for relocation. He emphasized that base is important for long-term retention. He can start 2026-11-02 if we can accommodate earlier notice with his current employer.

He asked if Redwood can confirm the band top explicitly; he shared that another opportunity is at a similar base but no sign-on. He asked for an answer by COB Tuesday.

Let me know how you want to proceed and whether legal/HR should prepare a conditional offer reflecting the counter.

Thanks,
Liz Harrington
Sr. Recruiter, TalentBridge
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Liz Harrington <liz@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval needed: Senior Billing Ops Lead comp authorization and offer details

Decision and next steps: approved.

Summary of approved offer to extend to Alex Rivera:
- Base salary: $175,000
- One-time sign-on: $10,000 (repayable if departure < 12 months)
- Relocation lump sum: $5,000 (fixed)
- Target start date: 2026-11-02 (flexible)
- Cost center: 4301, headcount slot H-17

Marissa — thank you for the headcount allocation. Vivek — thank you for the comp guardrails; we’re within the acceptable total first-year cash ($190k cap was referenced earlier). Laura/Neha — please initiate DocuSign offer (use template: Senior Billing Ops Lead v3), route to Alex for electronic signature, and copy TalentBridge. Please include repayment language for sign-on and standard background check contingency.

Liz — please confirm candidate availability for 2026-11-02 and share any outstanding docs. HR: please route the offer by EOD tomorrow; we want acceptance this week if possible.

Thanks all — let me know if anything else needed.

Karthik
Director, Billing & FP&A Partnerships
Redwood Inference
